metadata.name: moshsol
metadata.description: Bundle launchpad: locked backer vaults traded by rate-limited agents

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's ProgramData account; only its upgrade authority may initialize, which
prevents anyone from front-running initialization after deploy.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not authorized for this action

errors.name: InvalidMetadata
errors.msg: Name, symbol or URI too long or empty

errors.name: MinimumReached
errors.msg: Raise minimum was reached; refunds unavailable

errors.name: NotWhitelisted
errors.msg: Wallet is not on the whitelist

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: AgentPriceImpact
errors.msg: Agent trade exceeds max price impact

errors.name: AgentBuyNotDip
errors.msg: Agents may only buy below the EMA band

errors.name: AgentSellNotRally
errors.msg: Agents may only sell above the EMA band

errors.name: NoPendingAdmin
errors.msg: No pending admin or signer mismatch

errors.name: AgentAboveCostBasis
errors.msg: Agents may only buy below the vault's average cost, or buy back with sell proceeds below the average sell price

errors.name: AgentBelowCostBasis
errors.msg: Agents may only sell above the vault's average cost plus band

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program upgrade authority can initialize the platform

errors.name: SameSlotTrade
errors.msg: An agent trade and a public trade can't share a slot; retry in the next slot

errors.name: TermsChanged
errors.msg: Platform terms changed since this launch was prepared; review them and retry

fields.name: deposited
docs: Lamports deposited. Doubles as the fee-share weight.

fields.name: max_per_wallet
docs: 0 = no per-wallet cap

fields.name: whitelist_root
docs: All zero = open raise

fields.name: bundle_supply_bps
docs: Max share of supply the bundle buys at launch

fields.name: reserve_bps
docs: Share of the raise kept as SOL in the vault for agents to buy dips

fields.name: expected_terms
docs: Terms the creator reviewed; must equal what the platform would freeze into the launch now.

fields.name: max_create_fee_lamports
docs: Most the creator agreed to pay as the flat create fee.

fields.name: whitelist_root
docs: sha256 merkle root of allowed backer pubkeys. All zero = open to everyone.

fields.name: vault_cost_sol
docs: SOL cost basis of the tokens currently in the vault (average-cost method).

fields.name: ema_price
docs: Time-weighted EMA of the spot price, Q64.64 lamports per base unit. Updated with weight
dt / (dt + period) so it can never be snapped to a new level in one step.

fields.name: agent_tokens_sold
docs: Cumulative tokens sold by agents (with agent_sol_received gives the average sell price).

fields.name: buyback_sol
docs: SOL from agent sells not yet used for buy-backs. Buy-backs above average cost may only
spend this budget, and only below the average agent sell price.

fields.name: last_public_trade_slot
docs: Slot of the last public buy/sell and of the last agent trade. Agents can't trade in a slot
that already saw a public trade, and public trades can't follow an agent trade in the same
slot, so nobody can wrap a vault trade atomically (one transaction or one bundle).

types.name: LaunchTerms
docs: Economic terms copied from the platform at `create_launch`. They can never change for the
life of the launch, so backers know exactly what they signed up for.

fields.name: agent_authority
docs: The only key allowed to call agent_buy / agent_sell. It can never withdraw anything.

fields.name: trade_fee_bps
docs: Fee on every public trade, taken in SOL.

fields.name: backer_fee_share_bps
docs: Portion of the trade fee paid to backers (pro-rata to their deposit).

fields.name: creator_fee_share_bps
docs: Portion of the trade fee paid to the creator. Platform receives the remainder.

fields.name: launch_fee_bps
docs: Cut of the raised SOL taken at launch.

fields.name: create_fee_lamports
docs: Flat fee charged when creating a launch (anti-spam).

fields.name: virtual_sol_reserves
docs: Virtual SOL reserves seeded into every new curve (sets the starting market cap).

fields.name: agent_buy_bps_per_window
docs: Max share of vault SOL agents may spend per window.

fields.name: agent_sell_bps_per_window
docs: Max share of vault tokens agents may sell per window.

fields.name: agent_max_impact_bps
docs: Max price move from a single agent trade.

fields.name: agent_band_bps
docs: Agents buy only when price <= EMA * (1 - band) and sell only when price >= EMA * (1 + band).

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new launches and deposits. Never blocks refunds, trading or claims.

fields.name: agents_paused
docs: Blocks agent trades (circuit breaker). Vault funds stay locked either way.

fields.name: max_raise_lamports
docs: Beta cap on a new launch's `raise_max`; 0 = only the hard `MAX_RAISE_LAMPORTS` limit.

fields.name: max_wallet_deposit_lamports
docs: Beta cap on one wallet's total deposit into any raise, on top of the creator's own
`max_per_wallet`; 0 = no platform cap.

fields.name: sol_amount
docs: Lamports paid (buy, gross incl. fee) or received (sell, net of fee).
